source.prompt: House song, about 3.5 minutes, 124 BPM, A major. Bright, sunny summer-anthem mood, joyful and warm. Two smooth male lead vocalists trading lines in the verses and singing together in rich harmony on the chorus. Warm Steinway piano chords, soft Rhodes electric piano, lush string section pad, rolling finger bass, gentle mellow organ swells. Four-on-the-floor kick, claps on 2 and 4, offbeat open hats, light 16th hats, soft tambourine. Structure: instrumental intro (16 bars), verse, pre-chorus, chorus, short instrumental break, verse 2, chorus, stripped bridge with vocals and piano, final chorus, instrumental outro that fades. Clean, wide mix with a tight mono low end.
source.lyrics:
[Intro]
Oh-oh, oh-oh

[Verse]
Streetlights hum on the avenue
Every window wide and the air feels new
We roll the hours like a lazy wheel
Barefoot plans and a summer deal

[Pre-Chorus]
Turn it up, let the evening climb
Two hearts keeping the same old time

[Chorus]
We are gold in the heatwave
Shining loud till the night fades
Hands up high on the rooftop
Gold in the heatwave, never stop

[Verse 2]
Postcards curling in the July sun
Every corner sings to everyone
You laugh like thunder on a clear blue day
Hold my hand, let the music play

[Pre-Chorus]
Turn it up, let the evening climb
Two hearts keeping the same old time

[Chorus]
We are gold in the heatwave
Shining loud till the night fades
Hands up high on the rooftop
Gold in the heatwave, never stop

[Bridge]
When the city cools and the stars come through
I'll still be burning here with you
Slow it down, let the moment stay
Golden light won't fade away

[Final Chorus]
We are gold in the heatwave
Shining loud till the night fades
Hands up high on the rooftop
Gold in the heatwave, never stop
Gold in the heatwave, never stop
